children: According to Odaily, in response to the FBI's call for THORNode operators, RPC node operators, and DeFi platforms to block transactions related to the Binance attacker, THORChain co-founder Chad Barraford responded on X that THORNode operators have zero information that isn't already public and readily available in real time. "No subpoenas required, a best case scenario for investigations."

title: THORChain Co-founder Responds to FBI Interception Request: THORNode Information Is Publicly Available
